main_text.p: runt tamen inter se singula: quemadmodum Specie, propter diversitatem Materia; sic & Gradu, quantum ad obligandi vim. Sunt autem illa in triplici potissimum discrimine. Quædam enim constanter obligant, quorum rursus sunt duo genera: unum eorum quorum obligatio oritur ex potestate alterius, ut Leges humanæ, mandata Parentum, Dominorum, &c. 1.Alterum eorum quorum 2.obligatio oritur ex libera propriæ Voluntatis ele-ctione, ut Vota, Juramenta, Pacta, Promissa, & his similia: quædam verò ex accidenti tantùm obligant & velut ambulatoriè, pro hic & nunc, secundùm exigentiam circumstantiarum; ut Lex sive Ratio Scandali. 3.

III. Postulat ordinis ratio, ut à primo illo genere ordinamur, in quo familiam ducunt Leges Humanæ. De quarum obligatione quæ à nobis dicendi erunt, ad duas hasce quæstiones revocari possint universa. An sc. obligent conscientias Leges humanæ? & Quatenus obligent? Casuum plerorumque particularium determinatio ad posterio-rem quæstionem magis pertinet; de quâ (si Deus annuerit) instituentur futuræ aliquot prælectiones: priorem solam hoc tempore attingemus, hanc sc. An Leges humanæ obligent Conscientias: Subjectum quæstionis non indiget multa explicatione. I.Lex, sive primò à 1{1}legendo, i. e. eligendo dicto electivè, ut Ciceroni placuit, quòd Legislatores ea quæ Reipublicæ magis utilia fore judicabant eligerent: sive quod alii malunt, secundò, à legendo item, sed in alia significatione, eâque passivè acceptâ, quod oporteret Leges, mox ubi latæ essent, æneis tabulis incisas, autalias perscriptas & columnis appensas proponi in publico, ut à populo legeretur; sive denique ex aliorum mente tertiò, à {2}li-2gando, quòd subditos ad eos observandum obligarent. page.notes: Right margin notes: "1.", "2.", "3." beside the first paragraph are section numbers printed in the margin. "I." beside "Lex" is a marginal section number. Note 1 (margin, bottom right), transcribed as printed but doubtful: "Dd Gut[?] vim in Lege[?] penimus. Cic. I. de Legib." The first words are hard to read and may be "Dū su̇t" or similar. Note 2 (margin, bottom right): "Aquin. I. 2. qu. 92[?] art. 16[?]. Biel. 6. distinct. 3. 37. art 1." The numbers 92 and 16 are uncertain. "distinct." is printed with a long-s form. Running head and catchword "di" are as read; the catchword is uncertain. Left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Faint show-through at the top right is excluded.
